What is a couple Christmas photo generator?

A couple Christmas photo generator turns a photo of two people into a romantic or cozy Christmas couple portrait. On TheDigitalGifter, you upload one photo that includes both of you, choose a couple Christmas style, and create a downloadable portrait you can share privately or use in a Christmas card.

Create a Christmas Portrait Together

This experience is for two people — partners, engaged couples, husband and wife, or boyfriend and girlfriend. Upload one photo with both of you clearly visible, pick a Christmas look, and create a portrait made for the two of you.

What Couple Photos Work Best?

Use one clear photo where both faces are visible and neither person is heavily cropped out. Good lighting helps. Selfies can work when both people are recognizable.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use a selfie?

Yes, when both people are clearly visible and recognizable in the same photo.

Can both people stay recognizable?

That’s the goal. Start with a clear photo of both faces — avoid extreme blur or one person mostly out of frame.

Can I create a romantic Christmas portrait?

Yes. Choose romantic or cozy couple styles such as Romantic Snowfall, Cozy Fireplace, or Elegant Christmas.

Can I try different styles?

Yes. Pick from the couple Christmas styles on the page before you create.

Can I use the result as a Christmas card?

Yes. Portrait handoff into the Christmas Card Maker is supported.

Can I download it?

Yes. Download the finished couple portrait from the result screen when it’s ready.

What kind of photo should I upload?

One clear photo that includes both of you. Faces should be visible; JPEG, PNG, or WebP works.
